results.answer: The course uses Temurin 21 (LTS); do not install JDK 8 or 17. [1] Set `JAVA_HOME` to the JDK installation folder and add its `bin` folder to `PATH` (`%JAVA_HOME%\bin` on Windows or `$JAVA_HOME/bin` on macOS and Linux). [1] Also set up Maven 3.9.9 and its campus mirror, and IntelliJ IDEA Community Edition with the project SDK set to Temurin 21 and Maven configured. [1] Install MySQL 8.4 and create the `starit_course` database. [2]

Add the StarIT campus mirror to `~/.m2/settings.xml` (create the file if needed). It is much faster than Maven Central on campus networks. [1][2]

```xml
<settings>
  <mirrors>
    <mirror>
      <id>starit</id>
      <mirrorOf>central</mirrorOf>
      <url>https://maven.starit.example/repository/public/</url>
    </mirror>
  </mirrors>
</settings>
```

If you use IntelliJ, set its Maven “User settings file” to this `settings.xml`. [1]
